'''Cobalt Conglomerate''' was a company that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Mann Do'Kor'chok]] worked for the company as a [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]], and [[Quen Duo]] was employed as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
